lesson.grammar_point: want to / would like to + verb for goals (My dream is to...)

vocabmatch.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: to do something good after a lot of work
something you really want to have or do in your life
one small part of a big plan
a good result, when you get what you want
to open your business in new places

listenings.text: Hi, I am Rafael Costa, and I have an air taxi company in Rio de Janeiro. Today we have four helicopters and twenty employees. But I have big dreams for the future. I want to grow my company step by step. Next year, I want to buy two new helicopters. In three years, I would like to expand to Sao Paulo and open a second office there. My biggest dream is to fly to all the big cities in Brazil. Success is not fast, but I am ready to work for it.

Hi, it's Anna Brooks, from Brooks Flight School in Texas. Ten years ago, my dream was a flight school. My first step was very small: one plane and two students. Today we have fifteen planes and two hundred students. Now I want to achieve a new goal. I would like to open a school in Brazil, maybe in two years. My tip for you is simple. Write your goals on paper, and look at them every week. Don't wait for the perfect moment. Start today.

extra_audio.text: First, Mike asks Karina about her goals for the future. Then, Karina says her dream is to have an office in Miami. Next, she says she wants to grow her company and sell more aircraft. After that, she says her first step is to improve her English. Finally, Mike invites her to work with his partners in Miami.
